usage: deskops bind pill [-h] [--root ROOT] task pill

positional arguments:
  task         Task selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.
  pill         Pill selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.

Example:
  deskops bind pill task-fix-thing pill-phase-gate --root .

Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.
